basic_info.description: Nestled in the charming Sunnyside neighborhood, 626 Joost Avenue blends 1920s Edwardian craftsmanship with modern comforts. This sunlit home features original hardwood floors, new main-level windows, and a beautifully updated kitchen with stone countertops, modern cabinetry, and a stylish backsplash. Main level opes up to a spacious deck leading to a vast yard, perfect for relaxation or gardening - indoor/outdoor living at its finest. The home offers two spacious bedrooms, a remodeled bathroom, a full basement with ample storage, a two-car garage, laundry access, and a generous driveway. Conveniently located near Monterey Blvd shopping, Miraloma Park, Glen Park, and Sunnyside Playground, it also provides easy transit and freeway access. Nearby top-rated schools include CAIS, Lick Wilmerding, Riordan, Stratford, Waldorf, Lowell, and Sunnyside. This residence is a must-see for those seeking timeless elegance and urban convenience.
